spec.title: Zap application bridge
spec.p: This package contains only the Vibe application source proxy for Zap. The application declaration, installer, source dependencies, and release index locator are read from the resolved external Zap repository.

section.title: Upstream
section.p: The mutable application line is `refs/heads/1.1.0`. Each operation records the exact resolved commit and portable source-tree digest before installation. There is no 1.1.0 binary release; this bridge selects the 1.1.0 source build.
